description: Implement RyzellxFootballProvider (PRIMARY provider) with async httpx client, configurable base URL, all documented endpoints (/api/home, /api/matches/live, /api/matches/date/:date, /api/matches/range, /api/match/:id, /api/team/:id, /api/player/:id, /api/leagues, /api/league/:id, /api/league/:id/table), request timeout, HTTP status validation, JSON validation, retry only for transient failures (connection errors, 5xx), and normalization into ProviderMatch/ProviderTeam/etc. Primary for matches, fixtures, results, match detail, teams, players, leagues, standings, xG/stats when available. Never invent values — use None for unavailable fields.
steps: Create backend/app/providers/ryzellx.py with RyzellxFootballProvider class. Constructor: __init__(base_url: str, timeout_seconds: float = 10.0, retry_count: int = 2, cache: Optional[ProviderCache] = None). Create httpx.AsyncClient with timeout in constructor, close in __del__ or add async close() method.

Implement async _request(method: str, endpoint: str, params: Optional[dict] = None) -> dict helper. Wrap httpx calls in try/except: catch httpx.TimeoutException -> raise ProviderTimeoutError; catch httpx.HTTPStatusError with 4xx -> raise ProviderNotFoundError or ProviderHTTPError; catch httpx.HTTPStatusError with 5xx -> retry up to retry_count, then raise ProviderHTTPError; catch httpx.RequestError (connection) -> retry, then raise ProviderError; catch json.JSONDecodeError -> raise ProviderInvalidDataError. Log all requests and errors without exposing secrets.

Implement async get_matches_by_date(date: date) -> List[ProviderMatch]. Call GET /api/matches/date/{date.isoformat()}. Parse JSON response and normalize to ProviderMatch instances with source metadata (provider='ryzellx', source_id=upstream_id, fetched_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc), is_live=False). Use None for any field not in response. Check cache before request (key: f'ryzellx:matches:date:{date}', TTL: UPCOMING_FIXTURES_TTL if date >= today else HISTORICAL_MATCH_TTL).

Implement async get_matches_by_range(start_date: date, end_date: date) -> List[ProviderMatch]. Call GET /api/matches/range with params ?start={start_date}&end={end_date}. Normalize to ProviderMatch. Cache key: f'ryzellx:matches:range:{start_date}:{end_date}', TTL based on date range.

Implement async get_match(match_id: str) -> Optional[ProviderMatch]. Call GET /api/match/{match_id}. Return None if 404. Normalize to ProviderMatch with all available fields (score, xG, stats if present). Cache key: f'ryzellx:match:{match_id}', TTL: LIVE_DATA_TTL if is_live else HISTORICAL_MATCH_TTL.
Implement async get_live_matches() -> List[ProviderLiveMatch]. Call GET /api/matches/live. Normalize to ProviderLiveMatch. Cache key: 'ryzellx:matches:live', TTL: LIVE_DATA_TTL.
Implement async get_team(team_id: str) -> Optional[ProviderTeam]. Call GET /api/team/{team_id}. Return None if 404. Normalize to ProviderTeam. Cache key: f'ryzellx:team:{team_id}', TTL: METADATA_TTL.

Implement async get_player(player_id: str) -> Optional[ProviderPlayer]. Call GET /api/player/{player_id}. Return None if 404. Normalize to ProviderPlayer. Cache key: f'ryzellx:player:{player_id}', TTL: METADATA_TTL.

Implement async get_league(league_id: str) -> Optional[ProviderCompetition]. Call GET /api/league/{league_id}. Return None if 404. Normalize to ProviderCompetition. Cache key: f'ryzellx:league:{league_id}', TTL: METADATA_TTL.

Implement async get_standings(league_id: str) -> List[ProviderStanding]. Call GET /api/league/{league_id}/table. Normalize to List[ProviderStanding]. Cache key: f'ryzellx:standings:{league_id}', TTL: UPCOMING_FIXTURES_TTL.

Add docstrings explaining: 'Ryzellx is the PRIMARY provider for matches, fixtures, results, match detail, teams, players, leagues, standings, and xG/stats when available.' Include comment about configurable base_url and no hardcoded production URLs.
acceptance_criteria: RyzellxFootballProvider implements all 8 required async methods (get_matches_by_date, get_matches_by_range, get_match, get_live_matches, get_team, get_player, get_league, get_standings)
HTTP 4xx/5xx errors raise appropriate ProviderHTTPError or ProviderNotFoundError
Retries only for transient failures (connection errors, 5xx), max retry_count retries
All responses normalized to ProviderXxx models with source metadata (provider='ryzellx', fetched_at, etc.)
No invented values — None for unavailable fields (xG, stats, etc.)
Cache integration uses appropriate TTLs based on data type
findings: Successfully implemented RyzellxFootballProvider as PRIMARY provider for matches, fixtures, results, match detail, teams, players, leagues, standings, and xG/stats. Created backend/app/providers/ryzellx.py (942 lines) with async httpx.AsyncClient, configurable base URL (ryzellx_base_url in config.py), timeout (10s default), and retry behavior (max 2 retries for transient failures only). Implemented all 8 required async methods: get_matches_by_date, get_matches_by_range, get_match, get_live_matches, get_team, get_player, get_league, get_standings. HTTP error handling: TimeoutException -> ProviderTimeoutError; 404 -> ProviderNotFoundError; 4xx -> ProviderHTTPError; 5xx -> retry then ProviderHTTPError; connection errors -> retry then ProviderError; invalid JSON -> ProviderInvalidDataError. All responses normalized to ProviderMatch/ProviderTeam/ProviderPlayer/ProviderCompetition/ProviderStanding/ProviderLiveMatch with source metadata (provider='ryzellx', source_id, fetched_at, is_live). NEVER invents values - all optional fields use None for unavailable data (xG, stats, venue, etc.). Cache integration with appropriate TTLs: LIVE_DATA_TTL=30s for live matches, UPCOMING_FIXTURES_TTL=300s for upcoming fixtures, HISTORICAL_MATCH_TTL=3600s for finished matches, METADATA_TTL=3600s for teams/players/leagues. Status parsing handles multiple formats (live/1h/2h -> LIVE, ht -> HALF_TIME, ft/finished -> FINISHED, scheduled/ns -> SCHEDULED, postponed/cancelled/suspended). Exponential backoff for retries (max 10s). Request/error logging without exposing secrets. Added respx==0.20.2 to requirements.txt for HTTP mocking. Created comprehensive test suite (15 new tests in test_providers_multi.py): test_ryzellx_get_matches_by_date, test_ryzellx_get_matches_by_range, test_ryzellx_get_match, test_ryzellx_get_match_not_found, test_ryzellx_get_live_matches, test_ryzellx_get_team, test_ryzellx_get_player, test_ryzellx_get_league, test_ryzellx_get_standings, test_ryzellx_timeout_error, test_ryzellx_http_4xx_error, test_ryzellx_http_5xx_retry (verifies retry logic), test_ryzellx_invalid_json_error, test_ryzellx_cache_integration (verifies cache prevents duplicate API calls), test_ryzellx_normalization_none_values (verifies no invented values). All 43 tests in test_providers_multi.py pass (28 from FEAT-001 + 15 from FEAT-002). All 578 backend tests pass (10 skipped). No regressions. Updated backend/app/providers/__init__.py to export RyzellxFootballProvider. Updated backend/app/config.py with provider configuration: ryzellx_base_url (default: https://football-live-api.vercel.app), fotmob_base_url, openligadb_base_url, provider_timeout_seconds (10.0), provider_retry_count (2). Provider uses async context manager pattern with close() method for cleanup. Ready for next FEAT: FotMob and OpenLigaDB provider implementations.
